tasks.short: Serve on academic and administrative committees.

steps.what: Find and read the actual committee agenda and supporting policy papers
Debate policy, departmental matters and academic issues in committee
Write and check personal assigned actions in the existing task list
Save the checked personal action entry

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} committee folder and agenda links for locating the actual papers. Preserve source reading, debate and ordinary {PROJECT} action entry; no new minutes-writing duty is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supporting papers can be hard to locate.
tasks.human_edge: Offer reasoned judgement and negotiate institutional decisions.
tasks.altitude: Less document hunting; committee rights unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document folders and agenda links reduce finding papers, not committee deliberation.

assumptions: Boundary is ordinary member participation and actual assigned-action capture, not secretariat minutes. Secretariat already supplies agenda, document title, revision and link; missing links mean manual search. Teacher captures actual own actions in s3.
Native first; already linked papers earn zero. Provisional shares, no measured baseline. Personal action check is part of entry, no added approval. Save1 is fully retained schema granularity.
unknowns: Actual document finding and action capture effort
research_questions: Do current agenda links already remove paper hunting?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional20 source units reduced20 percent saves4 minus0.5 upkeep=3.5; half eligible navigation gives1.5. Debate, reading, action entry and save retained.

tasks.short: Participate in student recruitment, registration and placement.

steps.what: Find the relevant student application, registration status and placement requirements in student administration
Discuss study options, support actual registration and judge suitable placement with the student
Write and check the actual advice, recommendation and required registration fields
outputs: checked student advice entry and recipient copy

steps.what: Save the checked advice and registration entry in student administration
inputs: checked student advice entry and recipient copy

steps.what: Send the checked advice copy to the verified student recipient
inputs: checked student advice entry and recipient copy

tasks.design: Configure a native {OTHER} student-administration view for applications, registration and placement requirements. Keep actual advice, placement judgement and checked record writing human, with separate save and student send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student context occupies several native screens.
tasks.enabler_now: Native saved views and field layouts.
tasks.still_hard: Advising on fit and recognising individual support needs.
tasks.human_edge: Balance student aspirations with evidence and constraints.
tasks.altitude: Less context navigation; no admission or placement authority gained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native student administration views can reduce context retrieval without making placement decisions.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher participation across recruitment, registration and placement, not central admissions work. Student and administration supply ID, application, actual registration state and requirement version; missing or disputed fields are checked manually. Teacher produces advice and actual permitted registration fields in s3.

Native first. Provisional activity mix, not measured. No automated eligibility or placement decision. Existing configured view earns zero. Ordinary writing includes accuracy and destination checks; no added approval ceremony. Save and send1 each fully retained.
unknowns: Teacher permissions and actual activity mix
research_questions: Which current screens are repeatedly navigated by teachers?

incremental.description: Check student view permissions and requirement revisions

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked student advice entry and exact student record
s3 checked recipient copy and verified student destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional20 retrieval units reduced40 percent saves8 minus0.5 upkeep=7.5. Half eligible navigation gives3.5. Advice, judgement, actual fields, save and send unchanged.

tasks.short: Compile specialized bibliographies for outside reading.

steps.what: Search specialist catalogues and reference libraries for the actual reading topic
Read candidate materials and select appropriate philosophical or religious perspectives for students
Compile, format and check bibliography entries against the actual selected editions
Save the checked final bibliography for the reading assignment

tasks.design: Configure saved catalogue searches and native {OTHER} reference-manager citation styles. Import actual edition metadata and format the selected bibliography, retaining teacher selection and checks against original sources.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated searching and manual citation formatting.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing catalogue filters and reference-manager exports.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting representative perspectives and suitable editions or translations.
tasks.human_edge: Judge intellectual significance and student reading demands.
tasks.altitude: Less search repetition and formatting; reading selection unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: reference managers support catalogue metadata import and deterministic citation formatting; edition and translation checks remain necessary.

assumptions: Boundary ends at compiled bibliography, not separate LMS publication. Catalogue supplies title, author, edition, translator, date and identifier; teacher verifies actual editions in s2-s3 and manually repairs incomplete metadata. No model invents titles or references.

Native configuration first; already automated searches or formatting earn zero. Provisional shares not measured; source reading and edition checks fully counted. Save1 fully retained schema granularity. Accuracy check part of normal bibliography compilation.
unknowns: Current reference tooling and metadata coverage
research_questions: How much citation formatting remains manual after native configuration?

incremental.description: Repair import mappings and citation styles

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final bibliography with verified editions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional search25 at60 remaining saves10 and compilation29 at30 remaining saves20.3; gross30.3 minus1.5 upkeep=28.8. Half eligible search and formatting gives13.65. Selection and checks remain.

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events.

steps.what: Read actual event arrangements in the existing calendar invitation
Participate in campus or community event activities and conversations

tasks.design: Use the existing {CALENDAR} invitation for event arrangements and retain actual participation. No additional report, outreach campaign or recurring planning work is established for an attendee.
tasks.previous_blocker: The task is participation in shared events.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing calendar access already handles event details.
tasks.human_edge: Engage with campus and community interests.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in this participation task.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: calendar invitations provide event details; they do not replace personal event participation.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher participation, with event information lookup explicitly split. Organiser supplies actual time, place and programme in the invitation; teacher reads missing details manually. No attendee record write or report is part of the stated typical work; if required it must be separately timed rather than counted as saved participation.

Native calendar already suitable, no new configuration, hence zero new upkeep. Provisional shares, not measured. Event organisation is a different assigned role, no transfer of this teacher's labour is claimed.
research_questions: Does attendance entail a real record write beyond the existing invitation?

incremental.description: No new configuration or additional upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Five units of actual arrangement reading and95 actual participation retained; no new change or upkeep.
